code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    color = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0), 0)
    cells = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color and color != 0}
    comps = []

        start = cells.pop()
        comp = {start}
        q = [start]

            r, c = q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):

                    cells.remove(p)
                    comp.add(p)
                    q.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    obj = min(comps, key=len)
    r0 = min(r for r,c in obj); r1 = max(r for r,c in obj)
    c0 = min(c for r,c in obj); c1 = max(c for r,c in obj)
    return [[color if (r,c) in obj else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
'''
